current.text: Dunn has fallen off the fantasy radar.

Dunn is not among the projected Phoenix starters (Green, Booker, Brooks, Bridges, Ighodaro). He is also not among the bench players named in the team preview (Gillespie, Maluach, Kennard, Goodwin, Fleming).
Booker, Jalen Green, Bridges and Brooks are expected to take most of the Phoenix minutes and usage, which leaves little room for other wings.

durable.text: Dunn cannot shoot. He has made under 50% of his free throws in each of the last two seasons, but on very few attempts.

note: Dunn is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 288 and ESPN 217, both value him at 0 USD, and the only expert note says he has fallen off the fantasy radar. Both projections have him scoring about 6.7 points with no category strong enough to carry a punt build, so leave him on waivers. Watch only if injuries in the Phoenix wing rotation push his minutes well above 20 per game.
